blocks.text: FINAL TICKETS FOR TONIGHT’S ONE-NIGHT-ONLY EP LAUNCH SHOW AT TOWER CINEMAS IN NEWCASTLE AVAILABLE HERE LISTEN TO CHILD’S PLAY EP HERE Today, 16-year-old Australian rock wunderkind, Maple’s Pet Dinosaur has released her highly-anticipated debut EP, Child’s Play via Warner Music Australia and In Bloom. Listen HERE. The EP follows the releases of ‘Child’s Play’, the title track from her debut EP, and ‘Big Mouth’ and the sugar charged new single Ice Cream Truck. ‘Child’s Play’ and ‘Big Mouth’ have further cemented Maple’s global presence across social media, amassing 100,000s of likes over the last month alone with an ever-expected global fanbase […]...
